comment: The building blocks baldssl implements, shown on the website. Each pull request that implements one sets its status to `implemented` (and its `link` to the pull request). Statuses: implemented, in-progress, planned. The issues tracking each one are in tracking.json.

primitives.name: Base64, PEM and DER reading
primitives.purpose: Decoding certificates and keys: canonical base64, PEM framing, and a strict DER reader that rejects non-canonical encodings.

primitives.name: SHA-1 and SHA-2
primitives.purpose: Fingerprints, and the hashes signatures are computed over (FIPS 180-4), SHA-512/224 and SHA-512/256 included.

primitives.name: Randomness from the operating system
primitives.purpose: Key and nonce generation; the only code allowed to use unsafe.

primitives.name: Constant-time prime fields
primitives.purpose: Arithmetic modulo the primes of P-256, P-384, P-521 and Ed25519, without branches on secret values.

primitives.name: P-256, P-384 and P-521
primitives.purpose: The NIST curves by model (affine, projective with complete formulas, Jacobian), constant-time scalar multiplication, and the SEC 1 point encoding.

primitives.name: Ed25519
primitives.purpose: The Edwards curve of Ed25519, point encoding and decoding with a prime-order subgroup check, and the derivation of a public key from a private key (RFC 8032).

primitives.name: DER writer
primitives.purpose: Encoding ASN.1 structures, and DER syntax descriptions: one description per ASN.1 type gives both the reader and the writer, which round-trip and are canonical by construction (public keys use them).

primitives.name: Private keys (PKCS#8)
primitives.purpose: Generating keys and writing them as openssl genpkey does.

primitives.name: ECDSA
primitives.purpose: Signing and verifying with P-256, P-384 and P-521 (FIPS 186-5), for certificate requests, signing and verification.

primitives.name: HMAC and HMAC-DRBG
primitives.purpose: Message authentication (RFC 2104) and the deterministic random bit generator of SP 800-90A, for signature nonces and PBKDF2.

primitives.name: Ed25519 signatures
primitives.purpose: Signing and verification (RFC 8032), for Ed25519 requests, certificates and chains.

primitives.name: Reading keys
primitives.purpose: PKCS#8, SEC 1 and SubjectPublicKeyInfo in PEM and DER, compressed points included, for every command that takes a key.

primitives.name: RSA signature verification
primitives.purpose: PKCS#1 v1.5 and PSS (RFC 8017), to verify the RSA-signed chains found in practice.

primitives.name: RSA key generation
primitives.purpose: Probable primes as in FIPS 186-5, for `genpkey -algorithm RSA`.

primitives.name: AES and PBKDF2
primitives.purpose: AES-256-CBC (FIPS 197) and PBKDF2 (RFC 8018), for `enc` and PKCS#12.

primitives.name: secp256k1, X25519, X448 and Ed448
primitives.purpose: Keys and key agreement beyond the NIST curves and Ed25519 (RFC 7748, RFC 8032).

primitives.name: SHA-crypt
primitives.purpose: The `$5$` and `$6$` password hashes of `/etc/shadow`, for `passwd`.

primitives.name: TLS 1.3 client
primitives.purpose: Enough of RFC 8446 to fetch a server's certificate chain with `s_client`.

primitives.name: Arbitrary-precision integers
primitives.purpose: Integers of thousands of bits and modular arithmetic on them (Montgomery multiplication, exponentiation), constant time for secrets: the base of RSA, DSA and Diffie-Hellman.

primitives.name: Primality testing and prime generation
primitives.purpose: Miller-Rabin and random and safe primes, for RSA keys, DSA and DH parameters, and openssl prime.

primitives.name: RSA encryption
primitives.purpose: RSAES-PKCS1-v1_5 and OAEP, for pkeyutl, rsautl, CMS and S/MIME.

primitives.name: DSA
primitives.purpose: Domain parameters, keys, signing and verification, for dsa, dsaparam and gendsa.

primitives.name: Finite-field Diffie-Hellman
primitives.purpose: Parameters, named groups (RFC 7919), keys and key agreement, for dhparam and pkeyutl -derive.

primitives.name: Certificate revocation lists
primitives.purpose: Reading, printing, verifying and issuing X.509 CRLs, for crl, crl2pkcs7, ca and verify.

primitives.name: PKCS#7 and CMS
primitives.purpose: SignedData, EnvelopedData and the other CMS content types, for pkcs7, cms, smime, ts and PKCS#12.

primitives.name: OCSP
primitives.purpose: OCSP requests and responses (RFC 6960), for ocsp.

primitives.name: Time-stamp protocol
primitives.purpose: RFC 3161 requests, responses and tokens, for ts.

primitives.name: Key derivation functions
primitives.purpose: HKDF, scrypt, TLS1-PRF, SSKDF, X9.63 and KBKDF, for kdf, pkcs8 and HPKE.

primitives.name: MACs beyond HMAC
primitives.purpose: CMAC, GMAC, KMAC, Poly1305 and SipHash, for mac.

primitives.name: HPKE
primitives.purpose: Hybrid Public Key Encryption (RFC 9180), for Encrypted Client Hello.

primitives.name: More digests
primitives.purpose: SHA-3 and SHAKE, BLAKE2, MD5, RIPEMD-160 and SM3, for dgst and their shortcut commands.

primitives.name: More block ciphers
primitives.purpose: ARIA, Camellia, Triple DES and SM4 in their modes, for enc and their shortcut commands.
